newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve Bank of New York added temporary reserves to the U.S. banking system on Tuesday through a round of overnight system repurchase agreements, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The move was in line with Wall Street analysts' forecasts.
At 1030 EST/1530 GMT, the time when the central bank usually intervenes in the market, federal funds were quoted at 5-9/16, well above the Fed's target of 5-1/4 percent.

Many analysts expect the Fed's policy committee to raise the funds rate by 25 basis points to 5.50 percent at its policy meeting later today. The central bank's official announcement is expected at 1415 EST/1915 GMT.
Tuesday's market activity by the Fed does not have any monetary policy implications, experts noted.
